explanation.renderedLayer: Source parseMarker() returns null for landmarks with neither game nor real-world coordinates. In this snapshot that is 60 records → 3040 landmark markers (observed 3040); + 182 = 3222 (observed 3222).
explanation.confidence: Reproduced from source client code + our snapshot. The source's own GTADB sync revision is shown only in an admin endpoint, so equality of snapshots is inferred from matching counts, not verified.
explanation.ourHandling: The 60 records are kept, searchable in the data view, and flagged 'no coordinates'. 41 further records have real-world but no game coordinates; they appear in lists and the real-world view, not on the game map.
